summary: Scot A. McChesney, 55, of Wildernest, drowned at North Pond in Silverthorne after throwing himself off a paddleboard; Summit County Coroner ruled suicide caused by drowning
responding_agency: Silverthorne Police Department and partner law enforcement agencies; Park County SAR K-9 team assisted with the recovery effort
notes: Identified by Summit County Coroner Regan Wood on 2016-07-20. Surfaced via the Aug 2016 PCSAR Happenings roundup noting PCSAR dogs assisted with a drowning at North Pond in Silverthorne (out-of-county assist).
